The '''Prophecy''' was a type of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] manufactured by [[Walkhar]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Walkhar Prophecy first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the possible items players could receive from the Seneschal's Stronghold Pack.
